title: Sunny's Bookshop
deck: A loved brand, refined rather than reinvented.
role: Creative direction, rebrand and logo design
location: Tarzana and the NoHo Arts District, Los Angeles
lede: An independent bookshop with a brand its readers already loved needed it ready for a second store. The book was redrawn by hand; the rest was put in order.
challenge: Sunny's Bookshop is an independent bookshop and book bar in Tarzana, with a second shop coming to the NoHo Arts District. The owner, Sanaz Tamjidi, already had a brand people loved: a seal, a cursive signature, a dark green. She asked for it refined, not reinvented.
work: The open book was drawn by hand, in ink first, then cut down to a solid version that still reads at the size of a favicon. The signature was rebuilt to be read rather than admired: Sloop Script, tidied for legibility, with a custom S and the flourishes politely declined.

An SB monogram was set inside the seal's two rings, and a serif was paired with the script. The rules went into a 24-page brand bible, set like a book, because it was for a bookshop. Behind it sits a working archive of 46 pages of studies, from bookseller tickets and printer's marks to the pen paths of the signature.

The slogan didn't need writing. “For readers and writers” was already stitched into her label. A second mark followed for Sunny's Journal & Press, a wordmark and stamp in the same world, and an announcement film set the drawing, the type and the studies to the sound of the room.
system: Drawn in ink, with hero and small-size versions.
The book inside two rings; SB inside the rings.
Sloop Script with a custom S.
Library Green, Vellum, Ink Navy, Gilt, Binding Brown and Linen, with Pantone, thread and foil references.
deliverables: Hand-drawn book mark, hero and small-size versions
Horizontal, stacked, half-moon and signature lockups
Sunny's Journal & Press wordmark and stamp
Typography and color, with Pantone, thread and foil references
credits: Dalton Corr: creative direction, rebrand, logo design, brand bible, photography, announcement film
Sloop Script, Font Bureau, with a custom S
Cormorant Garamond, EB Garamond and Jost, SIL Open Font License
press: Delivered in October 2026: every mark in green, vellum, black and white, as SVG, PDF, EPS, Illustrator and PNG files, ready for the NoHo opening in 2027.
